policy.compatibility_review: Reviewed actual USDA Detail capture on 2026-11-16: SR Legacy record 171688, NDB9003, generic raw apple with skin, with no named cultivar. The photographed display name may remain apple. Existing variant=with_skin records visible edible skin, not a cultivar; unknown cultivar requires no Fuji inference. Missing skin evidence (variant=null), peeled/cooked/dried foods, juice, whole dishes and branded products are excluded. raw+mixed is the explicit legacy encoding for visibly unheated whole apple, not a claim of mixed cooking; unknown preparation is not a wildcard. The USDA Food Distribution Program annotation is part of the original source name, not a brand or photographed identity. All nine selected nutrients are present; trans fat zero is a reported source value, never an imputed missing value. This is a reference for the food class, not a measurement of the photographed apple or its weight.

rights.retention_policy: Retain selected nutrient cells, normalized profiles, portions and hashes with attribution and owner binding. Request, preview, cache and policy snapshots may persist. No cross-user cache approval is made.
rights.withdrawal_policy: Revoke future retrieval, authority, reuse and cache access using the existing source withdrawal transaction. Historical owner snapshots, policy versions and backups remain. No purge-on-withdrawal condition identified for CC0 data; exclude the source if a new deletion obligation is established.
